messages:
alex f: CI red on master — flaky unit test `TestServeLoop.NondetTimeout` on linux-x86_64. Failing 1/30 in CI, green locally for me. Anyone seen this?

maria g: @alex f thanks for the ping. link to the job? :eyes: 

ci-bot: Build 4755001 failed: https://ci.internal.redwood/4755001 — test `TestServeLoop.NondetTimeout` panicked. Artifacts: /artifacts/4755001/log.txt

alex f: log snippet: 
```
panic: assertion failed: retry_window == expected
serve_loop.go:482 runRetry()
serve_loop_test.go:128 TestServeLoop.NondetTimeout
```
I suspect a timing window around backoff reset.

tom s: I looked quickly — stack shows the failure inside the retry timer callback. Could be scheduler jitter + shared clock access. Is this the one that touches global `timeNow` in test shim?

jen r: yep, that test stubs time.Now in tests sometimes. We added a shim recently in #4283, maybe it wasn't fully isolated for parallel runs.

nate p: Repro attempt: `go test ./runtime -run TestServeLoop.NondetTimeout -count=50 -race` fails 1/50 on my machine with similar stack. I can try a bisect if someone points to a good baseline commit.

alex f: awesome repro, nate p. @jen r can you paste the shim change? suspect it leaks across subtests.

jen r: snippet: `var timeNow = time.Now // test can override` then tests do `defer func(){ timeNow = orig }()` but some tests spawn goroutines that read timeNow after defer runs.

maria g: that pattern is brittle. Quick fix candidate: make the shim a function scoped to the serve loop instance or use a locked accessor. Can someone try a quick patch and run CI?

tom s: I'll throw together a patch making the shim internal to the ServeLoop struct (inject Time func) and run the matrix. If CI still flakes, we can run git bisect between `main~20`..`main`.

alex f: thanks tom s — if you open a draft PR tag it with `ci:rerun-needed` and ask for a fast CI rerun. If it stabilizes, we can backport.

nate p: volunteering to run bisect if needed. Also can set up a nightly rerun job for that test to catch regressions.

jen r: TY! I'll review the draft this afternoon. Also adding a test-only mutex around time shim as short-term mitigation.

alex f: Great. For tracking: created an issue #6192 (note in thread) and assigned to eng-runtime. We can close once CI stays green for 24h. :white_check_mark:
